notes.title: Quest & Achievements Update
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue preventing quests from completing if you exited mid-quest
- Added 5 new achievements (Jack of All Trades, Underwater Dealer, Cub Master, Quest Conqueror, World Traveler)
